definitions.explanation: Adding a decorative or functional border or edge to something. Used for sewing, crafts, design, and also figuratively for visual outlining effects.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}の{縁取|ふちど}りがある{皿|さら}。
{赤|あか}い{縁取|ふちど}りの{付|つ}いたハンカチ。
{文字|もじ}を{白|しろ}で{縁取|ふちど}りすると{読|よ}みやすくなる。
examples.english: Outlining the text in white makes it easier to read.

notes: From {縁|ふち} (edge, border) + {取|と}り (taking, doing). Takes する to form a verb: {縁取|ふちど}りする (to border, to edge). Common collocations: {金|きん}の{縁取|ふちど}り (gold edging), {縁取|ふちど}りをする (to add edging). In graphic design, refers to adding an outline around text or shapes. In sewing and crafts, refers to adding decorative trim along edges.
